name: English
title: AastroAstra: Vedic Astrology
shortDescription: Kundali, numerology, matching and daily panchang in your language.
fullDescription:
Explore your birth chart, numerology and daily panchang with AastroAstra.

YOUR BIRTH CHART
Enter your birth details to explore kundali charts, planetary positions, nakshatra and dasha information. An unknown birth time makes some interpretations approximate.

YOUR NUMBERS
Explore your birth number, destiny number, name number and Lo Shu grid. Compare profiles and read the explanations behind the results.

MATCHING AND PANCHANG
Compare birth details with kundali matching and explore the daily panchang for your location.

AI EXPLANATIONS AND PHOTO READINGS
Ask questions about your chart, or choose a palm or face reading. Photo readings require consent before photos and relevant reading details are sent to an external AI provider. Palm photos remain on your device for history and retries. AastroAstra does not store face photos or use them to identify you. You can report AI content inside the app.

LANGUAGES AND ACCESS
The interface supports twelve languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Bengali, Punjabi, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Spanish and Chinese. Sign in with the code or link in your email.

This release offers free core features with usage limits. Subscriptions, paid consultations, wallet top-ups and marketplace purchases are not available.

AastroAstra is for guidance and entertainment. Astrology is not a science. The app does not provide medical, legal, financial or psychological advice. Consult a qualified professional for important decisions.

Questions or feedback: aastroastra@gmail.com
Account deletion: https://www.aastroastra.com/delete-account.html
Privacy policy: https://www.aastroastra.com/privacy.html
Terms: https://www.aastroastra.com/terms.html
releaseNotes: Seven more languages: Bengali, Punjabi, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Spanish and Chinese. Your account profile now has its own page in Settings, separate from saved kundalis. Clearer Panchang, settings and notification layouts. Replies can be read aloud, with the device voice as fallback. Palm and face photos stay upright. Hold an Ashtakoot point for an AI explanation. Buy credit packages through Google Play from the Credits sheet.
